azkar.text: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
azkar.transliteration: rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir
azkar.translation: My Lord, I am truly in need of whatever good You send down to me.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
azkar.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan
azkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ikfini bi-halalika 'an haramik, wa aghnini bi-fadlika 'amman siwak
azkar.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful instead of what You have made unlawful, and enrich me by Your grace so that I need no one besides You.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنِي
azkar.transliteration: allahumma barik li fima razaqtani
azkar.translation: O Allah, bless me in what You have provided for me.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي رِزْقًا حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَاسِعًا
azkar.transliteration: allahumma arzuqni rizqan halalan tayyiban wasi'an
azkar.translation: O Allah, grant me lawful, good, and abundant provision.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَمْلِكُهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlika wa rahmatika, fa-innahu la yamlikuha illa ant
azkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty and mercy, for none possesses them except You.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ رِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَاسِعًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka rizqan tayyiban wasi'an mubarakan fih
azkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for good, abundant, and blessed provision.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ فَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma iftah li abwaba fadlika wa rahmatika
azkar.translation: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your bounty and mercy.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اقْضِ عَنِّي الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنِي مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma iqdi 'anni ad-dayn, wa aghnini min al-faqr
azkar.translation: O Allah, settle my debt for me and free me from poverty.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي مَا أَهَمَّنِي وَارْزُقْنِي مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا أَحْتَسِبُ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ikfini ma ahammani, warzuqni min haythu la ahtasib
azkar.translation: O Allah, suffice me against what concerns me, and provide for me from where I do not expect.

azkar.text: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
azkar.transliteration: hasbiya Allahu la ilaha illa huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu, wa huwa rabbul-'arshil-'azim
azkar.translation: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.

azkar.text: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
azkar.transliteration: la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
azkar.translation: There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

azkar.text: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
azkar.transliteration: astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh
azkar.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him.

azkar.text: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
azkar.transliteration: rabbi ighfir li wa tub 'alayya, innaka antat-tawwabur-rahim
azkar.translation: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. Indeed, You are the One who accepts repentance, the Most Merciful.

azkar.text: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
azkar.transliteration: rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan, wa fil-akhirati hasanatan, wa qina 'adhaban-nar
azkar.translation: Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

azkar.text: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
azkar.transliteration: rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir
azkar.translation: My Lord, I am truly in need of whatever good You send down to me.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وَالْقِلَّةِ وَالذِّلَّةِ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-faqri wal-qillati wadh-dhillah
azkar.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from poverty, scarcity, and humiliation.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
azkar.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka al-huda wat-tuqa, wal-'afafa wal-ghina
azkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ رِضَاكَ وَالْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ وَالنَّارِ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka ridaka wal-jannah, wa a'udhu bika min sakhatika wan-nar
azkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Your pleasure and Paradise, and I seek refuge in You from Your anger and the Fire.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِي رِزْقِي وَوَسِّعْ عَلَيَّ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma barik li fi rizqi, wa wassi' 'alayya min fadlik
azkar.translation: O Allah, bless my provision and increase Your bounty upon me.
